**unified-asset-advisor v1.0.1 – Changelog**

- Removed the file `skill-card.md`.
- No changes to any core logic or features; this update only deletes documentation content.

Initial release of unified-asset-advisor, a unified skill for China macro and asset allocation analysis.

- Combines "asset-allocation-advisor," "macro-asset-advisor," and "asset-allocation" skill advantages into a single standardized workflow.
- Delivers asset allocation reports based on macro data and industry trends, supporting HTML (visual cards + industry chain maps), Markdown (full reports), and structured Excel (8 sheets).
- Uses AKShare (national statistics, Sina) and TDX Connector as core data sources; validates key economic figures via WebSearch as fallback; does not rely on unstable EM APIs.
- Covers end-to-end workflow: macro data → asset cycle judgment → industry filtering → industry chain analysis → product operation advice (A/H/QDII/ETF/Bond/Commodity) → futures/options strategy (with confidence rating and stop-loss reference).
- New ability to render industry chain SVG maps from structured TDX data; enhanced industry-level screening with trend, fund flow, and policy catalyst scoring.
- Multiple output formats (HTML, Markdown, Excel) are always generated together.
